## Why

A reviewer's Base overlays section covers only non-test Go files. In ork run ork-20261125-203303-45c3 (item S571), the reviewer needed the base version of a changed non-Go prompt file under `internal/roles/prompts`. It reached for `git grep ... HEAD`, which the read-only allowlist denies (`LocalReadOnlyAllowlist` in `internal/engine/perm.go:29-42` has `git show*` and `git -C * show*` but no `git grep`).

The owner decided on 2026-11-25 (adj 594, `roles.reviewer-git-grep`, option `no-allowlist-change`) to add no allowlist entry, because `git grep -O` can run a program. Instead, the Base overlays text in `internal/engine/baseoverlay.go` tells the reviewer to read the base version of any other changed file with `git -C WORKTREE show MERGEBASE:PATH`, which is already allowed. This slice adds that text and updates `docs/design.md` to match.

## Failing tests

All three go in `internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go` and use the existing `newHarness`, `baseOverlayRoutes`, `baseOverlayShow` and `baseOverlayBody` helpers.
- TestBaseOverlayNamesGitShowForNonGoFiles: the changed paths are `internal/x/x.go`, `internal/x/x_test.go` and `internal/roles/prompts/reviewer.md`, and the base routes `git show base:internal/x/x.go`. The Base overlays body still has exactly one entry line, for `internal/x/x.go`. It contains the command `git -C W show base:PATH`, built from `ShellWord(h.W)` and `ShellWord("base")`. It says that other changed files are not overlaid and that `git grep` is not available. It names neither `reviewer.md` nor `x_test.go`.
- TestBaseOverlayNoNonGoNoteForGoOnlyDiff: the changed paths are `internal/x/a.go` and `internal/x/b.go`, and no non-Go file changed. The body has no `git grep` text and no `show base:PATH` note. This keeps the one-line and combined-entry layouts that other tests pin.
- TestBaseOverlayUnreadableDiffNamesEveryChangedFile: when the changed paths cannot be read (`routes[1].Exit = 1`, as in TestBaseOverlayAdvisory), the incomplete notice tells the reviewer to trace the base version of each changed file, not only each Go file. It still contains `incomplete` and `git show`.

Regression: TestBaseOverlayNoSectionWithoutGoFiles, TestBaseOverlayBuildErrorIsOneShortLine and TestBaseOverlayAllTogetherWhenEverySingleFileFails keep passing unchanged.

2. In the diff-read-failure branch, change the text from "each changed Go file" to "each changed file". Keep the `git -C WORKTREE show MERGEBASE:PATH` form and the "does not block the run" sentence.
3. After the "left out" and "unread" paragraphs, and only when `otherChanged` is true, append one paragraph to the body. It says the overlays cover non-test Go files only. To read the base version of any other changed file, run `git -C <worktree> show <mergeBase>:PATH` (using `ShellWord` on the worktree and the merge base, as the existing unread notice does). It adds that `git grep` is not on the read-only list. The paragraph names no path and does not start with "- `", so `baseOverlayEntries` ignores it.
4. Leave the section absent when no non-test Go file changed, as now. Leave `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist` and the reviewer prompt unchanged.
5. Add the three tests above to `internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`.

Say that when the diff also holds any other changed file, the section tells the reviewer to read its base version with `git show MERGEBASE:path`. 7. Run `go test ./internal/engine`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check` and `adj lint`.
